# Source packages pinned to fork commits.
#
# Install this file with --no-deps before env/pip-requirements.txt:
#   pip install --no-deps -r env/source-requirements.txt
#
# This avoids resolver conflicts from old package metadata that points at the
# original upstream repositories while keeping the actual installed code pinned
# to the fork commits used for this VampNet environment.
